parameters.name: CheckGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the group to which the check item belongs.

parameters.name: CheckId
parameters.description:
The ID of the check item.

>  You can call the [ListCheckResult](~~ListCheckResult~~) operation to query the IDs of check items.

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: The instance IDs of the assets.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The description. The value of this parameter can be up to 65,535 bytes in length.

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
The type of the rule. Default value: **WHITE**. Valid value:

*   WHITE: adds check items to the whitelist.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas add-check-instance-result-white-list --check-group-id cQFq20UzZ49K6gRSJD13010000 --check-id 132 --instance-ids rr-uf69i5n62hyqu0000 --instance-list InstanceId=i-wz9fdluqx20mp2x70000 RegionId=cn-hangzhou --rule-type WHITE --remark test --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas AddCheckInstanceResultWhiteList --region cn-hangzhou --CheckId 132 --InstanceList.1.InstanceId 'i-wz9fdluqx20mp2x70000' --InstanceList.1.RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --CheckGroupId cQFq20UzZ49K6gRSJD13010000 --RuleType WHITE --InstanceIds.1 'rr-uf69i5n62hyqu0000' --Remark test
